reports.notes: Born-digital typed fillable form. Office field reads 'County Commission Seat A' (index.csv 'County Commission Seat A' - exact agreement). The ENTIRE address row (label bar included), the phone number and the signature block are redacted upstream by the county with wide black bars, so residence_city is ''; the email survives. FILER INCONSISTENCY, transcribed verbatim and NOT corrected: the form's formula makes Box F = Box A + Box B = 189.92, but the filer typed F = 0 (and a close of 0) - evidently reporting the net position after the equal-and-opposite expenditure. No arithmetic was applied. Boxes A, F and the close are typed '0' with no cents while B-E carry '$' and two decimals. Cover prints the filing address as 'disclosures@utahcounty.gov'.

Box C (Year to Date) prints the identical $189.92 and is NOT summed as an increment; this is the cycle's only report (a 30-days-after-withdrawal-or-elimination report dated 5/4/26), so period == year-to-date. THE SELF-CONTRIBUTION WAS TESTED AGAINST THE LADDER, not assumed: the sole donor is the candidate himself, Box A prints 0, and Box B prints the full 189.92, so the payment is an itemized contribution and not a beginning balance. NOTE, retained verbatim and NOT adjudicated: Box F ('Box A + Box B') prints 0 where A + B = 189.92, and the close box prints 0 where F - D would be -189.92. Both are balance-ladder cells that touch no itemized row; the side is gated on Box B, which the schedule's own two footers independently corroborate.

The two printed footers on each schedule are formatted with a DOUBLED dollar sign ('$ $189.92') because the filer typed his own '$' into a field the form already prefixes; that is a typing artifact, not a second figure.

Both conventions give 189.92 on each side and both close exactly.

itemized.notes: FORM CHARACTERISATION (2026 stock, fourth specimen) — variant modern_boxAF, footer 'v. 12.23' on every page, masthead 'Aaron Davidson, Clerk'. Four pages, summary LAST, each classified from its own printed header: p1 cover, p2 'Schedule A - Itemized Contributions Received', p3 'Schedule B - Itemized Expenditures Made', p4 'Summary Page'. NO CHECKLIST DECOY is bound in this document. Schedule A's third column is headed 'City and Zip Code' — the same blank Bowles (d4741fec) and Herrin (fea010e2) used, and NOT the 'Address and Zip Code' blank Voeks (a9fc51aa) used, all four under the identical v. 12.23 footer. Schedule B keeps the real Purpose column; both schedules are boxed 15-row grids printing their own two footers; the Summary Page prints A, B/C, D/E, F and an UNLETTERED close box. Report type '30 Days after withdrawal or elimination' is ticked, the amendment question is ticked 'No', and the report date is 5/4/26 on the cover and on every inner sheet's Date of Report box. Foliation is continuous counting the cover (Pages 1-4) with no 'of N' component printed. TYPING ARTIFACT worth naming so a later reader does not misread it as a second figure: the filer typed his own '$' into the two footer fields on each schedule, which the form already prefixes with '$', so those lines print '$ $189.92'. There is exactly one printed value on this document, 189.92, and it appears as Box B, Box C, Box D, Box E, both Schedule A footers, both Schedule B footers, the contribution row and the expenditure row. FILER ARITHMETIC RETAINED VERBATIM, NOT ADJUDICATED: Box F ('Box A + Box B') prints 0 where A + B = 189.92, and the close box prints 0 where F - D would be -189.92. The filer evidently reasoned that the campaign ended at zero — which is true in substance — but the boxes as printed do not follow the form's own formulae. Neither cell touches an itemized row and both sides gate on Box B / Box D, each corroborated twice over by the schedules' own footers. PAGE-FACE IDENTITY: cover, affirmation line and every sheet's candidate box read 'Christopher Forbush', matching index.csv. The OFFICE BOX IS FILLED AND LEGIBLE — 'County Commission Seat A' — in exact agreement with index.csv, corroborated from the page itself. REDACTION: this is a *_Redacted.pdf and the county blacked out the cover's entire address row INCLUDING ITS OWN PRINTED LABEL BAR, the phone number block, and the signature; the email address and the Office box were left in the clear. There is NO redaction on any schedule page. Because the only donor is the candidate and he typed no street, no cell on this filing was ever at risk of carrying an address. BORN-DIGITAL typed fillable form, but printed, redacted and re-scanned, so row confidence stays at the OCR tier 'medium' per SCHEMA §6.
